sections.heading: Arrive and settle in
sections.body: The workshop welcome desk opens at nine. Bring your booking email and ask the host for a tour.

sections.heading: What to bring
sections.body: Bring closed shoes and a refillable bottle. A notebook helps you keep project measurements.

sections.heading: Choose a session
sections.body: Choose a workshop session for your project and experience. Beginners can reserve an introduction with a host.

sections.heading: Change a booking
sections.body: Contact the welcome desk at least one day before your session to change a booking.

sections.heading: Thread the machine
sections.body: Use the printed threading guide beside the machine. Wind a fresh bobbin before starting your sewing project.

sections.heading: Check a test stitch
sections.body: Test the stitch on scrap fabric. The workshop host can help adjust tension and choose a needle.

sections.heading: Measure your material
sections.body: Write the finished measurements in your notebook. Check the wood for damage before marking a cut.

sections.heading: Work with tools safely
sections.body: Ask the workshop host for a tool introduction. Wear eye protection and keep the workbench clear.

sections.heading: Step-free access
sections.body: The workshop entrance and welcome desk have step-free access. Contact us to discuss a particular bench or tool.

sections.heading: Take a quiet break
sections.body: A quiet room is available beside the kitchen. Ask the host if you need a break from busy sessions.

sections.heading: Arrive by bicycle
sections.body: Covered bicycle parking is beside the workshop entrance. Lock your bicycle before checking in.

sections.heading: Arrive by bus
sections.body: The number twelve bus stops across the square. Follow the signed path to the welcome desk.
